instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll container is implemented for smooth fluid motion
All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-whatsapp-btn', data-testid='booking-submit-btn', etc.)
Header MUST be sticky with backdrop-blur background, NEVER full transparent without blur
WhatsApp link must be formatted as: https://wa.me/639558896008?text=...
Create custom Monogram SVG logo for 'irsmakup' and display in header & footer
Ensure responsive layout works perfectly on mobile viewports (mobile-first)
Backend endpoint `/api/inquiries` must handle POST requests with fields: name, phone, event_date, event_type, venue, pax, message
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use generic Inter font for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display
Maintain contrast compliance (APCA / WCAG AA). White text on dark buttons, dark text on light surfaces
Every button and input must have clear hover and focus states with visual feedback
No raw placeholder images — strictly use the provided curated unsplash/pexels URLs
